answer: No Sybil fleet survives peer-attested judgment. Each agent posts a ferrous-hard bond, then five non-kin reviewers grade its reasoning; a forged answer bleeds through the ledger like cheap pigment on wet paper — visible, slashable. To mint N fake identities you must fund N bonds AND pass N independent graders, not squat one island of spoofed keys. Counterfeiting judgment costs strictly more than earning it.
